name: Early-Stage Melanoma Benchmark Dataset
description: A curated dataset of early-stage melanoma images intended to serve as a standard test set for training and evaluating automated skin lesion classification algorithms.
reputation: A curated clinical test set of interest to dermatology and medical-imaging researchers but less widely adopted than larger public skin-lesion challenges (e.g., ISIC).
notes: Non-LLM benchmark; strong class imbalance and label ambiguity for early-stage lesions; sensitive to skin-tone and device bias; relatively small and clinically specialized.
